backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing trending media, user profiles, tracked shows, and role‑based access control with admin‑gated update functions and public query endpoints.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing trailer‑related bugs, reliability improvements, diagnostics, and the frontend files tied to each feature.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing functionality and design characteristics of all major frontend components, hooks, and styles.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment file showing optional TMDB API key configuration.
frontend/.gitignore: Git ignore rules for logs, build artifacts, editor files, environment files, and node_modules.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entrypoint mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling authentication state, TMDB health, profile setup, media selection, and modal control.
frontend/src/components/AddShowDialog.ts: Dialog for searching TV shows and adding them to a user's tracked list with error handling and authenticated actions.
Banner displaying TMDB API health warnings and fallback‑key messaging when the service is degraded.
frontend/src/components/ContentGrid.tsx: Displays trending content in a grid with loading, error, and empty states, rendering MediaCard items on click.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedRow.tsx: Shows a horizontally scrollable row of featured content with loading and error handling plus scroll controls.
frontend/src/components/FilterBar.tsx: Provides dropdown filters for media type and sorting, with an optional badge showing the selected type.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders site footer with credits, links, and TMDB attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Displays site header with branding and login/logout logic using Internet Identity and user profile data.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Large hero section with a background image, title, and tagline promoting trending content.
frontend/src/components/MediaCard.tsx: Card component showing media info, trailer trigger, rating, and TV show tracking actions with authentication checks.
frontend/src/components/NetflixTop10.tsx: Displays a Top 10 list styled with rankings, using trending content and MediaCard components.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Modal dialog for entering and saving a user's name during profile setup.
frontend/src/components/TrackedShows.tsx: Displays the user's tracked shows with loading, error handling, image rendering, and removal actions using query hooks.
frontend/src/components/TrailerModal.tsx: Modal that fetches and displays a trailer for a selected media item with lifecycle logging, error states, and iframe reset handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the user's identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity login, logout, and identity loading via context, wrapping AuthClient setup and state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains react-query hooks for TMDB and backend interactions, including tracked shows, trailers, health checks, and utility fetch logic.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind-based styles defining light/dark themes, animated gradients, and custom scrollbars with glass and neon aesthetics.
frontend/src/lib/devDiagnostics.ts: Development-only logging utilities for trailer, media, and iframe lifecycle events without exposing sensitive data.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts: Declares Vite-specific TypeScript types, including an optional TMDB API key env variable.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, color tokens, animations, plugins, and content paths with extended UI variables.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s versioned state, including overall app summary and a list of implemented frontend features with metadata.
